name: agent-cred
description: Scoped credential issuance and verification for agent-to-agent calls

scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait postgres
scripts.db:verify: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U agentcred -d agentcred -c '\dt'
scripts.report:denials: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U agentcred -d agentcred -f - < db/reports/denials-last-hour.sql
scripts.phase3:test:unit: pnpm issuer:test && pnpm verifier:test && pnpm --filter @agent-cred/verifier-sdk build && pnpm --filter @agent-cred/agent-b test && pnpm --filter @agent-cred/agent-a test
scripts.phase3:test:integration: pnpm issuer:test:integration && pnpm verifier:test:integration && pnpm --filter @agent-cred/agent-b test:integration
scripts.phase3:typecheck: pnpm --filter @agent-cred/issuer typecheck && pnpm --filter @agent-cred/verifier-sdk typecheck && pnpm --filter @agent-cred/agent-b typecheck && pnpm --filter @agent-cred/agent-a typecheck
scripts.phase3:build: pnpm --filter @agent-cred/issuer build && pnpm --filter @agent-cred/verifier-sdk build && pnpm --filter @agent-cred/agent-b build && pnpm --filter @agent-cred/agent-a build
scripts.phase3:verify: pnpm phase3:test:unit && pnpm phase3:test:integration && pnpm phase3:typecheck && pnpm phase3:build
